description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for specifying search filter parameters related to employee allowed languages within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class, manages an employee number property, and sets a default sort field.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLanguageSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object that encapsulates filter parameters for searching employee allowed languages, including employee number and sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to 'l.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number filter value.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.
